end.parentNote: Saanvi practised using an egg tray as one group of ten and loose eggs as ones. They identified ten and counted loose eggs, but mixed up the written digits with the ten-and-ones model; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, show a full group of 10 objects plus loose objects and ask, “How many tens? How many ones?”
